description: The true path through Watson's timeline (world.html): the moves a careful reader makes, in order, each at the paragraph `at` where the page first allows it, to the end of the story. `do`: circle or cross (a possibility `pick` of question `q`; a wrong answer is tried, its clash seen, then crossed out), trust (a `link` key or a `person` set to `level`, on the detail of `on`), a (`a` changed into `b`), b (what `of` needs and does), c (`of` serves `for`), plan (open "What would this need?" on `of`), stop / compare / account (a check `key` on an open plan), hold (a likely clash `strain` set aside). `on`: what the move works on, opened in the detail panel first (a fact id, `q:<question>`; by default the move's own `a` or `of`). `see`: a pattern that must be on the page after the move (what the move shows the reader). `for_q`: the gated questions the move serves. `why`: the reader's thought, in plain words. `hint_at`: the paragraph from which a hint may offer the move, when later than `at` (Mapleton: the reader's own reach at ¶40, the page's support only from ¶114, the user's ruling). `late` (none at present): why a move comes after the paragraph the page first allows it (otherwise the check fails it). Played by scripts/path-check.mjs.
